saurabh-gupta-374262128

gupta24789

Summary

Results-oriented Data Scientist with 8+ years of experience in leveraging advanced analytics, machine learning, and deep

learning to extract actionable insights from large, complex datasets. Proven success in solving business challenges by designing and deploying scalable, end-to-end data-driven solutions. Skilled in Python, Pytorch, SQL and cloud platforms,

with a track record of delivering measurable improvements in operational efficiency and revenue growth. Experienced in collaborating with cross-functional teams and mentoring junior analysts, driving innovation through cutting-edge

machine learning models. Committed to continuous learning and staying ahead of industry advancements.

Professional Experience

Phenom pvt ltd - Bangalore

Product Development Engineer II Jan 2025 - Present

Edge has been acquired by Phenom, integrating Edge's capabilities into the Phenom platform.

AVR Edge Networks Pvt Ltd. - Bangalore

Feb 2018 - Dec 2024

Data Scientist - II (Dec 2020 - Dec 2024)

Led a team of three data scientists, overseeing project delivery, mentoring team members, and ensuring adherence to best practices in machine learning and data engineering.

Designed and developed a Skill Intelligence Assistant leveraging OpenAI, LangGraph, and Chainlit to enable users

to efficiently manage and structure skill taxonomy.

Developed multiple OpenAI LLM-based prompts to automate and optimize key processes, including job

description generation and data validation, resulting in improved system efficiency and enhanced user experience.

Fine-tuned the LLaMA 2 model using QLoRA for skill recommendation, achieving a 10% improvement in

recommendation accuracy.

Designed and developed a Knowledge Graph by modifying the translation model to recommend skill and title ontologies, resulting in a 20% improvement in hit@10 accuracy.

Fine-tuned the Sentence Transformer model on demand-supply pairs to enhance matching, resulting in a 10% improvement in Mean Average Precision (MAP).

Designed and implemented a skill and title normalization engine, enhancing underlying capabilities and improving

model performance through Sentence Transformer training.

Optimized the skill extraction engine by training the LSTM based model, resulting in a 5% improvement in supply recommendation accuracy.

Machine Learning Engineer (Feb 2018 - Nov 2020)

Trained Word2Vec and GloVe models on job description data to identify related skills and titles, resulting in a 15% improvement in model performance.

Enhanced demand forecasting engine to predict future demand for upcoming quarters, enabling clients to

optimize supply allocation and improve resource planning.

Developed descriptive and prescriptive dashboards to provide insights into demand and supply, helping clients identify critical demands and internal fulfilment opportunities, resulting in reduced hiring costs and improved

cost efficiency.

Implemented a Streamlit-based monitoring dashboard to capture system metrics, providing clarity on system

performance and measuring the impact of changes.

Designed and developed interactive PowerBI dashboards, empowering clients to make data-driven decisions and significantly enhancing user experience.

IBM India pvt ltd - Noida

Associate System Engineer Jan 2017 - Jan 2018

Designed and implemented an ETL pipeline to streamline data extraction, transformation, and loading from multiple

sources, reducing data processing time by 20%.

Performed exploratory data analysis (EDA) and data cleaning, applying statistical techniques to derive actionable insights, resulting in 5% improvement in model performance.

Skills

Programming & Libraries

Data Visualization

Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, Transformers, LLM, PEFT, LangChain, LangGraph, Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy

PowerBI, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Streamlit

Machine Learning Data Science, AI, Statistics, Exporatory Data Analysis(EDA),

Database Technologies SQL, MongoDB, Elastic Search, Postgres

Feature Engineering, Descriptive & Predictive Modeling, NLP, Time-Series Analysis, Recommender Systems

Tools & Deployment Jupyter, Git, Docker, DVC, MlFlow, CICD, Kubernetes

Cloud Platforms AWS, Google Cloud, Azure

Projects

Fine Tuning of LLM models

Fine-tuned LLaMA 2 and GEMMA models using QLoRA techniques on a sample dataset.

Enhanced skill-matching tasks, improving model efficiency and performance.

 https://github.com/gupta24789/fine-tuning-llms

Fine Tuning of Sentence Transformer

Optimized SentenceTransformer models on task-specific datasets to improve semantic similarity detection.

Achieved enhanced performance in text retrieval and ranking tasks.

 https://github.com/gupta24789/sentence-transformers/blob/main/03_train_st.ipynb

Named Entity Recognition

Developed and optimized deep learning models (LSTM, CNN + LSTM, SpaCy) for named entity recognition.

Achieved an 88% F1-score after rigorous training and validation, surpassing baseline performance.

 https://github.com/gupta24789/named-entity-recognition

Emotions Detection

Utilized BOW and TFIDF techniques for baseline emotion detection (F1-score: 75%).

Implemented advanced deep learning models (RNN, LSTM, fine-tuned transformer models), achieving a 91% F1-score.

 https://github.com/gupta24789/sentiment-analysis

Duplicate Question Pairs

Developed a Siamese network for duplicate question detection.

Achieved a 74% F-score for effective duplicate pair identification.

 https://github.com/gupta24789/siamese-networks

Education

M Tech (NIT Bhopal)

B Tech (Ideal Institute of technology, Ghaziabad)

Computer Science (9.03 CGPA)

Computer Science (73.98%)

Certifications

Deep Learning Specialization - Coursera

This specialization covers neural networks, CNNs, RNNs, sequence models, and deep learning frameworks such as

TensorFlow. Developed expertise in model optimization, hyperparameter tuning, and applying deep learning techniques to

real-world challenges.

NLP Specialization - Coursera

This specialized focused on natural language processing, covering text processing, language models, sentiment analysis,

and sequence labeling. Gained hands-on experience with state-of-the-art NLP techniques and frameworks, applying them

to real-world tasks.
